price.basis: the Search plan's price per 1,000 requests, with $5 of free credit every month and 50 queries per second; the Answers plan ($4 per 1,000 plus tokens) is not this interface

reachability.note: The vendor's pages state no regional availability for mainland China; its list of unavailable jurisdictions could not be read (HTTP 403).

brave-web-search-reference.source: Brave Search API documentation: web search get-started, query parameters and the GET /res/v1/web/search reference (api-dashboard.search.brave.com)
brave-web-search-reference.note: GET https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search with the `X-Subscription-Token` header as the only required header; `q`, `count` (1–20, default 20), `offset`, `country` (includes CN), `search_lang` (includes zh-hans, zh-hant), `ui_lang`, `freshness`, `safesearch`; results at `web.results[]` with `title` and `url`.

brave-search-api-pricing.source: Brave Search API product and pricing page, brave.com/search/api
brave-search-api-pricing.note: Search: "$5 per 1,000 requests", "Includes $5 in free credits every month", "50 queries per second". The page says nothing about availability in China.

openQuestions: Whether the API is reachable from mainland China without a proxy is the evaluation's measurement, not a vendor statement.
